notes.content:

Maintenance time will be as follows:

South America (PET): 20:00

[u][b]The server maintenance originally planned for October 8th will take place on October 12th.[/b][/u]

* [url=https://www.nttgameonline.com/knight/en/news/news_detail/1265][u][b]Knight Royale[/b][/u][/url] Event has started.


* [b]Kitchen Thief[/b] Event has started! [b](4 Weeks)[/b]
- Yellow Spitz monsters in front of [b]Moradon [/b]gates have stolen food ingredients! Catch them and deliver [b]10 food ingredients[/b] daily to [b][Lunar Lady] Magpie NPC.[/b]
[img]https://filegate.nttgame.com/knight/images/upload/TdLYPrKFwjAtqXS.jpg[/img]
- With the Mysterious Firecracker item given by Magpie NPC, you can summon a random monster and claim your reward.
[img]https://filegate.nttgame.com/knight/images/upload/KpDZXrFfexA5Plt.jpg[/img]

- Possible monsters and drops are listed below:
[b]Haetae[/b] - Mugwort Rice Cake, Cactus Rice Cake, Gardinia Rice Cake, and Pumpkin Rice Cake
[b]Yellow Spitz[/b] - Stellar Tattoo (1 Day)
[b]Escaped Turkey[/b] - Nimbus Tattoo (1 Day)
[b]Leftover Bone[/b] - Monster Stone
[b]Yellow Spitz Owner[/b] - Lunar Tattoo (1 Day)

[b]* I Love Knight Online Monster Stone Event (4 Weeks)[/b]
- Premium users will receive a Monster Stone in addition when claiming the "I Love Knight Online" emblem from Akara's Altar.
- Monster Stones obtained from Akara's Altar will be deleted 12 hours after being received.
[u]- Bronze Premium is not included in this event.[/u]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11526171/504b044d52a8bcfe55d450373d0c12accbb68d05.png[/img]
Please be aware that on August 27th, we will be having a scheduled maintenance on Knight Online servers. During maintenance game services and web portal will be temporarily unavailable.

Maintenance time will be as follows:

Knight Online Server Time (EST): 20:00
South America (PET): 20:00
Turkey: 04:00

You can find the details regarding the server maintenance on August 27th, 2025 below.
[h3][b][ New Events ][/b][/h3]
*[b] [/b][url=http://www.nttgameonline.com/knight/en/news/news_detail/1257][b][u]Full Moon Rift[/u][/b][/url] event has begun. [b](4 Weeks)[/b]
* [url=http://www.nttgameonline.com/knight/en/news/news_detail/1255][b][u]Puzzle[/u] [/b][/url]event has begun. [b](4 Weeks)[/b]
* [url=http://www.nttgameonline.com/knight/en/news/news_detail/1253][b][u]Invasion of Bunnies[/u][/b][/url] event has begun. [b](4 Weeks)[/b]
* [b]Ronark Land 50 Kill Quest [/b]event has begun. [b](4 Weeks)[/b]

Kill 50 enemies on the Ronark Land map and earn 15 Draki Commander Badges.[/u]
[img]https://filegate.nttgame.com/knight/images/upload/YHenCR7wA4kTNVy.png[/img]
You will need Battle Order 3 to complete the mission. (Battle Order 3 expires 12 hours after obtaining.)

[h3][b][ [Event Manager] Aset Updates ][/b][/h3]
* [b]Ibexs[/b] and [b]Crisis Potions[/b] have been added to NPC Aset. [b](4 Weeks)[/b]
[img]https://filegate.nttgame.com/knight/images/upload/4pV7PSvmHd2DAtB.jpg[/img]
[b]- Normal Purchase:[/b]
Crisis: 105m
Ibex: 70m
[u]Note: When purchased this way, potions are tradable.[/u]
[b]- Purchase with DC Premium / War Premium:[/b]
Ibex: 55m
Crisis: 80m
[u]Note: When purchased this way, potions are non-tradable.[/u]

* [b]Stat Scroll [Limited Edition][/b] items have been added to NPC Aset. [b](4 Weeks)[/b]
[img]https://filegate.nttgame.com/knight/images/upload/JCl4yxWNQmnqfSt.jpg[/img]
[u]Stat Scrolls obtained from Aset provide 2 more stat points than their Power Up Store versions.[/u]
- Types and prices:
[b]Scroll of Strength (L) [Limited Edition][/b]: 20m Noah
[b]Scroll of Health (L) [Limited Edition]:[/b] 20m Noah
[b]Scroll of Dexterity (L) [Limited Edition]:[/b] 20m Noah
[b]Scroll of Inteligence (L) [Limited Edition]:[/b] 10m Noah
[b]Scroll of Magic Power (L) [Limited Edition]:[/b] 10m Noah
[b]Spell of Lion's Strenght (L) [Limited Edition]:[/b] 30m Noah

* [b]Buff Pet Scroll[/b] items have been added to NPC Aset. [b](4 Weeks)[/b]
[img]https://filegate.nttgame.com/knight/images/upload/4ecmvC5MyQnRSLE.jpg[/img]
- Types and prices:
[b]HP 200[/b]: 50m Noah
[b]AC 20:[/b] 50m Noah
[b]Atk 5:[/b] 60m Noah

* [b]Resurrection Scroll 90%[/b] has been added to NPC Aset. [b](4 Weeks)[/b]
[img]https://filegate.nttgame.com/knight/images/upload/y36LuxljqvVNnB8.jpg[/img]
Price: 60m Noah

* [b]Special Nereids[/b] have been added to NPC Aset. [b](4 Weeks)[/b]
[img]https://filegate.nttgame.com/knight/images/upload/d84ZchfEM6ntpbJ.jpg[/img]
- Types and prices:
[b]Attack:[/b] 90m Noah
[b]Defence:[/b] 90m Noah

* [b]Equipment Confirmation Item[/b] has been added to NPC Aset. [b](4 Weeks)[/b]
[img]https://filegate.nttgame.com/knight/images/upload/zGW6QugNncHpx3D.jpg[/img]
Price: 5m Noah (10 pieces)

[h3][b][ System, Interface, etc. Changes ][/b][/h3]
* Whisper blocking system has been updated.
[img]https://filegate.nttgame.com/knight/images/upload/BlKybU61sEHdv4P.jpg[/img]
With the new system, you can disable whispers for different groups:
[b]- Common:[/b] Unchecking the box blocks PMs from all general players.
[b]- Clan/Union:[/b] Unchecking the box blocks PMs from players in your Clan/Alliance.
[b]- Friend:[/b] Unchecking the box blocks PMs from friends on your friends list.
[u]Once you check/uncheck any box and close the settings menu, the changes will be applied.[/u]

* Fixed an issue where certain weapons' passive effects could activate when teleporting party members to your location as a Mage.
* Twisted Moradon Fugitive event monster tweaked for properly giving the loot to the player who delivers the last hit to the monster.
* Fixed an issue where equipping the Minerva Helmet would change the character's hair colour to a different one.
* Some changes have been made to the "Ticket Exchange Use" menu on Minerva:
- Added a Transparent Minerva option for Minerva voucher types.
- Fixed the Gold / Red Dragon Voucher to give race-specific wings when activated by Karus or Elmorad characters.
- Fixed an issue where “+number” text was appearing on Transparent Minerva items.
* Fixed an issue where the "Add_Friend" command under the Private tab in the menu opened with the "H" key did not open the menu to enter a player name.
* The "Block all merchant messages" option has been removed from the "Block Chatting" menu.
* Number of Magic Bag slots that can be actively used has been increased to 3.

[h3][b][ Ended Events ][/b][/h3]
* Loyal Knight Achievement event has ended.
* Random Wing Giveaway event has ended.
* Baby Dragon Hunt event has ended.
* Eslant [Daily Party] Quests EXP Boost event has ended.
* Ronark Land Daily Party Quests event has ended.
* Knight Marble event has ended.
* Arena of Manes event has ended.
* Pathos' Gloves and HP/Armor/Attack Scroll package sales event at NPC [Event Manager] Aset has ended.
* I will continue playing Knight Online event has ended.
- Players who completed the event requirements have been awarded 30 Super Weapon Bulk Up Scrolls (Untradeable). Rewards not claimed will be deleted from the in-game mail system within 30 days.

Have fun!
[b]NTTGame | Knight Online Team[/b]

notes.title: [Server Maintenance] August 12th 2025, 20:00 EST
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11526171/504b044d52a8bcfe55d450373d0c12accbb68d05.png[/img]
Please be aware that the weekly maintenance will be on August 12th this week, We will be having a scheduled maintenance on Knight Online servers. During maintenance game services and web portal will be temporarily unavailable.

Maintenance time will be as follows:

Knight Online Server Time (EST): 20:00
South America (PET): 20:00
Turkey: 04:00

You can find the details regarding the server maintenance on [b]August 12th, 2025[/b] below.
[h3][b][ New Events ][/b][/h3]
* Ronark Land Bowl Lobo Boss event has begun! [b](4 Weeks)[/b]
- The Lobo Boss will spawn every 3 hours.
- The respawn time may randomly shift forward or backward.
- It drops the same items as the previous Lobo Boss.

[h3][b][ System, Interface, etc. Changes ][/b][/h3]
* A flashing icon feature has been added to the Windows Taskbar under certain conditions.
- When the game is in windowed mode and running in the background, the Knight Online icon on your system's taskbar can now flash to alert you in certain situations.
- This feature does not work when Genie is active, when the game is in windowed mode at maximum resolution, or when it's in full-screen mode.
When the game is in windowed mode and minimized to the background, you will be alerted with flashing in the taskbar in the following situations:
- When you are teleported into events like Chaos, BDW, Juraid.
- When your character dies.
- When a party invitation is received.
- When a trade request is received.
- When your character takes damage.
- When your character makes a sale in merchant mode.
- When you receive a whisper (private message).

* In quests that previously required delivering Acid Potions, the required item has been changed to Stone of Life instead.
* Performance improvements have been made for DirectX 11.
* The issue where abilities selected with right-click on the skill bar sometimes did not show the purple border effect has been fixed.
* The hover effect when placing your cursor over items in the inventory or skills on the skill bar has been made more noticeable.
* Fixed an issue where some recovery abilities on Genie (e.g., Priest's Past Recovery skill) were being activated based on MP ratio instead of HP.
* In the Genie - Support tab, the use of party-wide abilities has been adjusted to be cast based on the person using the skill.

[h3][b][ Ended Events ][/b][/h3]
* The Ronark Land Bowl Lycaon event has ended.
* The Juraid Mountain - Daily Coin Exchange event has ended.
* The Monthly Ranking Event has ended. Rewards have been sent to players who placed on ranks.
- Rewards not received via in-game email will be deleted from the email system after 30 days.

Have fun!
[b]NTTGame | Knight Online Team[/b]

Please be aware that on July 16th, we will be having a scheduled maintenance on Knight Online servers. During maintenance game services and web portal will be temporarily unavailable.

Maintenance time will be as follows:

Knight Online Server Time (EST): 20:00
South America (PET): 20:00
Turkey: 04:00

You can find the details regarding the server maintenance on [b]July 16th, 2025[/b] below.

[h3][b][ New Events ][/b][/h3]

* [b]Ronark Land Bowl Lycaon Boss[/b] Event has begun! [b](4 Weeks)[/b]
- [b]Lycaon[/b] Boss will appear every 3 hours.
- Respawn time may randomly shift forward or backward.
- Drops are the same as the previous [b]Lycaon[/b] Boss.

 
* [b]Juraid Mountain – Daily Coin Exchange[/b] event is here! [b](4 Weeks)[/b]
[img]https://filegate.nttgame.com/knight/images/upload/yFcZsWwLpe8Tm1X.png[/img]
For 4 weeks, by joining the Juraid Mountain event, [b]you can earn 2x “Daily Coin” items when you win and 1x when you lose.[/b]
[img]https://filegate.nttgame.com/knight/images/upload/EYpKV34UW8kB7bw.jpg[/img]
- Collect [b]30x Daily Coins[/b] and turn them in to [b][Fortune Teller] Mekin[/b] NPC to receive the “Solar Tattoo (30 Days)” item once per account.
[img]https://filegate.nttgame.com/knight/images/upload/d8HFxV3vNmy2GrE.png[/img]
​[b][u]- Only 1 participation per account is allowed. The item will be activated immediately.
- The “Daily Coin” item used in this event will be deleted after the event ends.[/u][/b]

[h3][b]​[ System, Interface, etc. Changes ][/b][/h3]
* Activation of many items, such as cospre, emblems, etc., has been consolidated into a single menu on [b][Vendor] Kaira.[/b]
[img]https://filegate.nttgame.com/knight/images/upload/LBDhGEUkyQ6fRCH.gif[/img]​
- You can access the interface via the [b]"Ticket Exchange Use"[/b] menu located on the [Vendor] Kaira NPC on the Moradon map.
- After accessing the interface, right-click on the item you want to activate from your inventory or drag and drop it into the box. Select the desired cospre option and collect your item.
- The existing exchange menus will be removed during the next maintenance.
- Some exchange tickets will remain to be exchanged in the existing old way.
[b]- With the new system, Kurian / Portu characters can ONLY use Minerva armor types. Valkyrie / Bahamut / Yeniceri / Gryphon types CANNOT be activated by Kurian / Portu characters. If you are playing a Kurian / Portu character, please pay attention to this detail when purchasing these items from PUS.
- Valkyrie / Bahamut / Yeniceri / Gryphon types could be activated on other (Rogue/Warrior/Priest/Mage) character types on the account and could be transferred to Kurian / Portu characters through storage. When worn by Portu / Kurian, appearance changes wont be applied, but attributes will be applied.[/b]

* Corrections have been made to multiple items, interfaces, and quest texts.

 
[h3][b][ Ended Events ][/b][/h3]
- Ronark Land Lupus Boss Spawn Event has ended.
- Juraid Mountain – Daily Coin2 Exchange event has ended.
- Ronark Land Defeat 100 Enemies Quest event has ended.

Have fun!
[b]NTTGame | Knight Online Team[/b]

Knight Online Server Time (EST): 20:00
South America (PET): 20:00
Turkey: 04:00

[h3][b][ New Events ][/b][/h3]
* [url=https://www.nttgameonline.com/knight/en/news/news_detail/1227][b][u]Daily Login[/u][/b][/url] event has started. [b](4 Weeks)[/b]
* [url=https://www.nttgameonline.com/knight/en/news/news_detail/1229][u][b]Ultima's Dungeon[/b][/u][/url] event has started. [b](4 Weeks)[/b]

[h3][b][ [Event Manager] Aset Updates ][/b][/h3]
* Special Defense Scroll item sale that you can buy from NPC [Event Manager] Aset has started! These items, which you can buy for 30,000,000 Noah, provide 5 defense increase against the weapon type you choose.
[img]https://filegate.nttgame.com/knight/images/upload/N8DaXctkeySfCzr.png[/img]

* The Minerva item sale, which you can purchase for 50,000,000 Noah via NPC [Event Manager] Asset, has started!
[img]https://filegate.nttgame.com/knight/images/upload/r7F56uK9gCwfWqa.png[/img]

* NPC [Event Manager] The Prayer of Priest item sale, which you can buy from Aset for 30,000,000 Noah, has started! The item gives +55% attack when bought from Aset. (Valid for the Priest class.)
[img]https://filegate.nttgame.com/knight/images/upload/Fmn8EDyefQwuMh3.png[/img]
[img]https://filegate.nttgame.com/knight/images/upload/2ztXbmEkY6Nn3a1.png[/img]

* Aset Draki Pendant S Raffle has been added to the game. [b](4 Weeks)[/b]
- You have the chance to win Draki Pendant S item for 15 Million Noah.

* Twisted Moradon Fugitive Event has started! [b](4 Weeks)[/b]
[img]https://filegate.nttgame.com/knight/images/upload/KjtTwCSJGMcvfaW.jpg[/img]
- The boss will appear on the Eslant map.
- The boss will appear every 8 hours.
- When the boss is killed, the players around him will receive EXP and the Polluted Holy Water item.
- The player who made the last attack on the creature will receive the 30-day Event Emblem item.
[img]https://filegate.nttgame.com/knight/images/upload/Q6ZHvMAsj8FYe51.jpg[/img]

* I love Knight Online event has started. [b](July 2nd ~ July 30th)[/b]
- Players who collect 20 or more "I Love Knight Online" emblems from Akara's Altar between July 2nd ~ July 30th will earn 20 Hero's Vows after the server maintenance on July 30th.

* July monthly ranking event will start. [url=https://www.nttgameonline.com/knight/en/news/news_detail/1225][b][u](Click for details!)[/u][/b][/url]

[h3][b][ System and UI Updates][/b][/h3]
* Minimize button added for temporary inventory.
[img]https://filegate.nttgame.com/knight/images/upload/XrZxJbp3F1wLS76.gif[/img]
* Potion Merchant and DC Sundries NPCs have been added to the Ronarkland map. The relevant NPCs are located in front of the Warp Gate.
* Visual changes have been made to Nereids Fairy.
* Monster Stone will not be used when the character's HP is less than half.
* "Skip" option has been added to avoid entering the VIP password again after entering it once. You must enter the password once to use this feature.

* The amount of creatures that spawn as 2 has been reduced to 1.
Satiros
Nightmare
Apostle of the Storm
Half Troll Berserker
Iron Claw
Doom Knight
Death Wizard
Giant Golem

* Draki's Pendant S, S.S and S.S.S levels have been updated to make an announcement when it is crafted/raised.
* The problem with the Coin notification system that appears on the screen has been fixed. (Sometimes the amount of coin received was not appearing on the screen at all.)

[h3][b][Ended Events][/b][/h3]
* Coin event has ended.
* Knight Royale event has ended.
* Aset Hero Wing and Tattoo sales event has ended.
* Sheep Looking Kaul and Mother event has ended.
* White Rose event has ended.
* "I will continue playing Knight Online" event has ended and the prizes have been sent to the winners.
* Aset "Iron Necklace" raffle event has ended.

Have fun!
[b]NTTGame | Knight Online Team[/b]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11526171/504b044d52a8bcfe55d450373d0c12accbb68d05.png[/img]
Please be aware that on June 18th, we will be having a scheduled maintenance on Knight Online servers. During maintenance game services and web portal will be temporarily unavailable.

Maintenance time will be as follows:

Knight Online Server Time (EST): 20:00
South America (PET): 20:00
Turkey: 04:00

You can find the details regarding the server maintenance on [b]June 18th, 2025[/b] below.

[h3][b][ New Events ][/b][/h3]
* Ronark Land Bowl Lupus Boss Event[/b] has started! [b](4 Weeks)[/b]
- Lupus Boss will spawn every 3 hours.
- Respawn time may randomly shift slightly.
- Drops are the same as the previous Lupus Boss drops.
 
[img src="https://filegate.nttgame.com/knight/images/upload/yFcZsWwLpe8Tm1X.png"][/img][b]
* Daily Coin2 Exchange Event[/b] has started! [b](4 Weeks)[/b]
By participating in the [b]Juraid Mountain[/b] event over 4 weeks, you can earn [b]2x Daily Coin2 items for a win and 1x Daily Coin2 item for a loss.[/b]
[img src="https://filegate.nttgame.com/knight/images/upload/Xh7E28nZtKeT3S6.jpg"][/img]
- By collecting [b]30 Daily Coin2[/b] items and delivering them to [b][Fortune Teller] Mekin[/b], you can receive the "Redistribution Item (Non-Tradeable)" once per account.
[img src="https://filegate.nttgame.com/knight/images/upload/pLCAlPefhrVt9YT.jpg"][/img][u][b]
- Only 1 participation per account is allowed. The item is non-tradeable / non-sellable.[/b][/u]
[u][b]- The Daily Coin2 item used in the event will be deleted after the event ends.[/b][/u]
 
[img src="https://filegate.nttgame.com/knight/images/upload/qpfmztA6wbaHlQV.png"][/img]

* Ronark Land Defeat 100 Enemies Quest Event[/b] has started! [b](4 Weeks)[/b]
- By killing [b]100 enemies[/b] around the [b]bowl area[/b] in [b]Ronark Land[/b], you can complete the quest [b]"[Ronark Land] Defeat 100 Enemies"[/b] and receive a [b]Superior Draki Supply Box[/b] as a reward.
- In Ronark Land, [b]Karus players[/b] can get Battle Order 3 and the quest from [b][Reserve Knight] Hill[/b], and [b]Elmorad players[/b] from [b][Reserve Knight] Lily[/b].
- Battle Order 3 will be deleted 12 hours after it is received.
- This quest cannot be completed simultaneously with other kill quests.
 
[h3][b][ System, Interface, etc. Changes ][/b][/h3]
* A white outline has been added to the red cooldown effect on skills to make it more visible.
[img src="https://filegate.nttgame.com/knight/images/upload/LU3GeagxnjlfSJK.gif"][/img]
* Fixed an issue where the party voice chat channel would sometimes close when a player left the party.
* Announcement messages that appear in chat for successful / failed item upgrades and unique items obtained by players have been updated.
* Upgrade announcements will now appear for Steel Lion weapons as well, starting from +7 success or failure.
* Fixed the issue where Genie attack mode would sometimes not perform "Basic Attack (R)" when using Transformation Scroll while in a party.
* The chance to obtain the "Sheep Looking Kaul" item by killing the enemy players has been disabled for the Ardream map.
 
[h3][b][ Ended Events ][/b][/h3]
* Ronark Land Bowl Lobo Event has ended.
* Juraid Mountain Daily Coin Event has ended.
 
Have fun!
[b]NTTGame | Knight Online Team[/b]

[b]* [url=http://www.nttgameonline.com/knight/en/news/news_detail/1216][u]Fugitive Kaul Event[/u][/url][/b] has started! [b](4 Weeks)[/b]
 
[b]* Pale White Rose Event[/b] has started! [b](4 Weeks)[/b]
On the [b]Ronark Land[/b] map, you have a chance to obtain the “[b]Pale Rose[/b]” item by hunting monsters near your character's level or defeating enemy players.
- You can exchange the [b]"Pale Rose"[/b] item at [b][Lunar Lady] Magpie[/b] NPC in [b]Moradon[/b] for the following rewards:

[table]			[tr]			[th]Pale Rose Quantity[/th]			[th]Reward[/th]		[/tr]				[tr]			[td]15[/td]			[td]Rose Candy[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]30[/td]			[td]Monster Stone[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]40[/td]			[td]Groom/Bride Transformation Scroll[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]50[/td]			[td]Magic Bag (7 Days)[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]70[/td]			[td]Oreads (7 Days)[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]80[/td]			[td]Blue Alencia Wings (7 Days)[/td]		[/tr]	[/table]
[b]- Rose Candy[/b] grants +5 points to all stats for 30 minutes.
[u][b]- Rose Candy and Pale Rose event items will be deleted after the event ends.[/b][/u]
 
[b]* I will continue playing Knight Online Event[/b] is here! [b](4 Weeks)[/b]
- Between [b]June 4th ~ July 2nd[/b], players who collect 20 or more "I will continue playing Knight Online" emblems via [b]Akara's Altar[/b] will earn a [b]7-day Special Oreads Voucher[/b] after the July 2nd server maintenance.
- Rewards not claimed from the in-game mail system will be deleted after 30 days.

[h3][b][ [Event Manager] Aset Updates ][/b][/h3]
*  [b]Battlefield Hero's Wing [/b]and[b] Lunar Tattoo [/b]sales event has started on [Event Manager] Aset NPC! [b](4 Weeks)[/b]
- War Hero Wing (30 Days) & Lunar Tattoo (30 Days): 190m Noah
- War Hero Wing (30 Days): 90m Noah
- Lunar Tattoo (30 Days): 120m Noah
 
[b]* Iron Necklace Draw[/b] option has been added to [Event Manager] Aset NPC [b](4 Weeks)[/b]
- For 4 weeks, you can try your luck through the “Box Purchase or Open” menu by selecting “Iron Necklace Draw” for 15,000,000 Noah to have a chance at obtaining [b]Iron Necklace (+0)[/b]!
- When you select the option and press the “Yes” button in the upcoming menu, your chance will be attempted directly. No box-type item is added to your inventory; the draw is instant.

[h3][b][ System, Interface, etc. Changes ][/b][/h3]
* Previously, if only one player removed a friend, the other player would still see them on their friend list. This has been changed, now, when a player removes someone, the removal will be mutual.
- Friend list records that remained one-sided from before this change will be automatically removed from the affected players' lists when they log into the game.
* The death notification message for players killed by Guard Summon has been updated to appear as “Nickname's Guard Summon defeated Nickname (Coordinates)”.
* All timed items now display their remaining duration in a [b]“[/b]x Days[b]”[/b] format.
- For example, durations previously written as “1 Month” from now on will appear as “30 Days”.
* The [b]"[/b]Potion of soul[b]"[/b] obtained by dismantling items through the Disassembling menu on [Mysterious] Narki NPC has been made identical to the “Potion of Soul[b]”[/b] sold by Potion Merchant NPCs.

[h3][b][ Ended Events ][/b][/h3]
* Puzzle Event has ended.
* Full Moon Rift Event has ended.
* Red Chicken Invasion Event has ended.
* The sale event for Ibex, Crisis, Stat Scroll [Limited Edition], Buff Pet Scroll, Resurrection Scroll 90%, Special Nereids, and Equipment Confirmation items on [Event Manager] Aset NPC has ended.
* The Chitin Shield Draw event on [Event Manager] Aset has ended.
* I Love Knight Online Event has ended. Quests for accounts that met the event requirements have been reset.
* The Steel Lion Weapon Box Exchange menu has been removed from [Event Manager] Aset.

Have fun!
[b]NTTGame | Knight Online Team[/b]

notes.title: [Server Maintenance] May 7th 2025, 20:00 EST
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11526171/504b044d52a8bcfe55d450373d0c12accbb68d05.png[/img]

Please be aware that on May 7th, we will be having a scheduled maintenance on Knight Online servers. During maintenance game services and web portal will be temporarily unavailable.

Maintenance time will be as follows:

Knight Online Server Time (EST): 20:00
South America (PET): 20:00
Turkey: 04:00

You can find the details regarding the server maintenance dated [b]May 7th, 2025[/b] below.

[h3][b][ New Events ][/b][/h3]
* [url=https://www.nttgameonline.com/knight/en/news/news_detail/1206][u][b]Full Moon Rift[/b][/u][/url] event has started. [b](4 Weeks)[/b]
* [url=http://www.nttgameonline.com/knight/en/news/news_detail/1202][u][b]Puzzle[/b][/u][/url] event has started. [b](4 Weeks)[/b]
* [url=http://www.nttgameonline.com/knight/en/news/news_detail/1204][u][b]Red Chicken Invasion[/b][/u][/url] event has started. [b](4 Weeks)[/b]
 
* [b]I love Knight Online[/b] event has started. [b](4 Weeks)[/b]
- Between [b]May 7th ~ June 4th[/b], players who obtain 20 or more "I Love Knight Online" emblems through Akara's Altar will earn the right to a quest reset after the June 5 server maintenance.
[b]- The quest reset will affect all characters on the account.[/b]

[h3][b][ [Event Manager] Aset Updates ][/b][/h3]
* [b]Chitin Shield Draw[/b] option has been added to the [b][Event Manager] Aset[/b] NPC [b](4 Weeks)[/b]
- [b]For 4 weeks[/b], you can try your luck with the “Chitin Shield Draw” option under the “Box Purchase or Open” menu for 15,000,000 Noah and have a chance to obtain a [b]Chitin Shield (+3)[/b]!
- After selecting the option, if you click the “Yes” button in the upcoming menu, you will immediately do an attempt. No box-type item will be added to your inventory; the chance attempt happens immediately.
 
* [b]Ibexs[/b] and [b]Crisis[/b] Potion items have been added to NPC Aset. [b](4 Weeks)[/b]
[img]https://filegate.nttgame.com/knight/images/upload/4pV7PSvmHd2DAtB.jpg[/img]
[b]- Normal Purchase:[/b]
Crisis: 105m
Ibex: 70m
[u]Note: When purchased this way, the potions are [b]tradable[/b].[/u]
[b]- Purchase with DC Premium/War Premium:[/b]
Ibex: 55m
Crisis: 80m
[u]Note: When purchased this way, the potions are [b]untradable[/b].[/u]
* [b]Stat Scroll [Limited Edition][/b] items have been added to NPC Aset. [b](4 Weeks)[/b]
[img]https://filegate.nttgame.com/knight/images/upload/JCl4yxWNQmnqfSt.jpg[/img]
[u]Stat Scroll items obtained from Aset provide 2 more stat points than their Power Up Store versions.[/u]
* Types and prices:
[b]Scroll of Strength (L) [Limited Edition][/b]: 20m Noah
[b]Scroll of Health (L) [Limited Edition]:[/b] 20m Noah
[b]Scroll of Dexterity (L) [Limited Edition]:[/b] 20m Noah
[b]Scroll of Inteligence (L) [Limited Edition]:[/b] 10m Noah
[b]Scroll of Magic Power (L) [Limited Edition]:[/b] 10m Noah
[b]Spell of Lion's Strenght (L) [Limited Edition]:[/b] 30m Noah

* [b]Buff Pet Scroll[/b] items have been added to NPC Aset. [b](4 Weeks)[/b]
[img]https://filegate.nttgame.com/knight/images/upload/4ecmvC5MyQnRSLE.jpg[/img]
- Types and prices:
[b]HP 200[/b]: 50m Noah
[b]AC 20:[/b] 50m Noah
[b]Atk 5:[/b] 60m Noah

* [b]Resurrection Scroll 90%[/b] item has been added to NPC Aset. [b](4 Weeks)[/b]
[img]https://filegate.nttgame.com/knight/images/upload/y36LuxljqvVNnB8.jpg[/img]
Price: 60m Noah

* [b]Special Nereids[/b] item has been added to NPC Aset. [b](4 Weeks)[/b]
[img]https://filegate.nttgame.com/knight/images/upload/d84ZchfEM6ntpbJ.jpg[/img]
- Types and prices:
[b]Attack:[/b] 90m Noah
[b]Defence:[/b] 90m Noah

* [b]Equipment Confirmation[/b] item has been added to NPC Aset. [b](4 Weeks)[/b]
[img]https://filegate.nttgame.com/knight/images/upload/zGW6QugNncHpx3D.jpg[/img]
Price: 5m Noah (10 pieces)

[h3][b][ System, Interface, etc. Changes ][/b][/h3]
* The voice chat system settings interface has been updated.
- Options and functions in the numbered areas on the visual:
[img]https://filegate.nttgame.com/knight/images/upload/sVjmbvHyCEzRndN.jpg[/img]
- [b]Area 1:[/b] Select the desired device for listening to other players from the available list and save the configuration by clicking the “Apply Speaker” button. Unchecking the “Listen to Voice Chat” box disables incoming voice chat audio.
- [b]Area 2:[/b] Choose the preferred device for the microphone from the listed options. If the “Voice Chat Microphone” box is unchecked, the microphone will be disabled for voice chat. Additionally, adjust the in-game microphone volume using the “Increase Microphone” section to control the transmitted sound level. The system volume of the microphone can also be modified via the “Windows Microphone” option.
[img]https://filegate.nttgame.com/knight/images/upload/WSl3TshcFkw5f9U.png[/img]
- [b]Area 3:[/b] Enabling the “Microphone Input Sensitivity” option sets the activation threshold for microphone transmission, reducing background noise heard by other players.
- [b]Area 4:[/b] Checking the “Disable Auto-Open Options Window” option prevents the automatic pop-up of the settings menu upon joining a new party.
- [b]Area 5:[/b] Enabling the “Push-to-Talk” setting allows users to activate the microphone by holding the designated key selected in the menu.
 
* The issue where characters sometimes spawned inside objects when teleporting to the Ronark Land map has been fixed.
​* 100 Ladder Points requirement has been added to enter the Chaos event. 100 Ladder Points will be taken from your character the moment you click “Apply” button.
- Players with Premium can still participate without 100 Ladder Points.
* The issue where character names with active Stealth / Hide skills were visible even from afar when Cat's Eye or Lupine Eyes skills were active has been fixed.
* The damage of the poisonous gas in the Knight Royale event has been updated to increase by phase.
Damage increases by phase:
Phase 1 – 50 HP Damage
Phase 2 – 60 HP Damage
Phase 3 – 70 HP Damage
Phase 4 – 80 HP Damage
Phase 5 – 90 HP Damage

[h3][b][ Upcoming Changes ][/b][/h3]

* After the maintenance on May 22nd, the requirement to complete the “Fallen Angel” quest will change from needing 1x “Horn of Comprehension” item to hunting 15 Fallen Angels.

[h3][b][ Ended Events ][/b][/h3]
* Knight Marble event has ended.
* Manes' Arena event has ended.
* [Event Manager] Aset Pathos' Gloves and HP/Armor/Attack Scroll packs sale event has ended.
* Wild Grass event has ended.
* Giant Worm event has ended.
* [Event Manager] Aset - Ring of the Felankor Draw event has ended.
* [Event Manager] Aset – Steel Lion Weapon Box sale event has ended.
[b][u]- The Steel Lion Weapon Box exchange menu option will remain active until the June 5 server maintenance. After June 5, the menu will be removed, and Steel Lion boxes will no longer be openable.[/u][/b]
* I will continue playing Knight Online event has ended.
- You can exchange the item via [b]"[Manager] Billbor"[/b] located in the Moradon map (815,670).
- Rewards not claimed from the in-game mail system will be deleted after 30 days.

Have fun!
[b]NTTGame | Knight Online Team[/b]

notes.title: [Server Maintenance] April 23rd 2025, 20:00 EST
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11526171/504b044d52a8bcfe55d450373d0c12accbb68d05.png[/img]

Please be aware that on April 23rd, we will be having a scheduled maintenance on Knight Online servers. During maintenance game services and web portal will be temporarily unavailable.

Maintenance time will be as follows:

Knight Online Server Time (EST): 20:00
South America (PET): 20:00
Turkey: 04:00

You can find the details regarding the server maintenance on [b]April 23rd, 2025[/b] below.

[h3][b][ New Events ][/b][/h3]
* [b]Ronark Land Bowl Lycaon Boss[/b] event has begun! [b](4 Weeks)[/b]
- Lycaon Boss will spawn every 3 hours.
- Respawn time may randomly vary forwards or backwards.
- The boss will drop the same items as the original Lycaon Boss.
 
[img]https://filegate.nttgame.com/knight/images/upload/kXjCH9sm2hKqrLW.png[/img]
* [b]Juraid Mountain - Daily Coin2[/b] event is here! [b](4 Weeks)[/b]
For 4 weeks, by participating in the Juraid Mountain event, you will receive [b]2x “Daily Coin2” items upon winning and 1x upon losing.[/b]
- By collecting 30x Daily Coin2 items and delivering them to [b][Fortune Teller] Mekin[/b] NPC, you will earn the right to obtain a [b]“Character Delete Scroll”.[/b]
- To use the Character Delete Scroll item, you must visit [b][Fortune Teller] Mekin[/b] NPC.
- You will need to open the "Character Delete" menu.
- After confirming, you can enter your VIP Key password.
- In the window that opens, you must select the character you wish to delete.
- Once you add the item, accept the final confirmation to complete deletion of the character.
[b]- Character Delete Scroll item is single-use.
- Characters that are in jail, has 10 JR penalties, in a clan, or who are king cannot be deleted.
- A deleted character's name cannot be reused by another character.
- Daily Coin2 items will be deleted when the event ends.[/b]

[h3][b][ System Changes ][/b][/h3]
* The item looting system has been updated in [b]Under the Castle[/b] and [b]Ultima's Dungeon[/b] events.
- This change applies to the main boss monsters in the UTC event and Ultima boss in Ultima's Dungeon.
- The higher the damage ratio you deal to the boss, the higher the chance you will be able to loot it — similar to how it works with Eslant bosses and Felankor, etc.

* Improvements have been made to the FPS issues caused by the Windows 11 24H2 version on some systems.

[h3][b][ Upcoming Events ][/b][/h3]

* I Love Knight Online Event is coming soon! [b](May 7th)[/b]
- Between [b][u]May 7th and June 4th[/u][/b], players who collect 20 or more "I Love Knight Online" emblems via Akara's Altar [b]will get their quests reset[/b] after the June 4th server maintenance.
- Quest reset will affect all characters across the account.
 
[h3][b][ Ended Events ][/b][/h3]
- Ronark Land Lupus Boss Event has ended.
- Juraid Mountain Daily Coin Event has ended. The quests of characters who delivered 30 Daily Coins to [Fortune Teller] Mekin have been reset.

Have fun!
[b]NTTGame | Knight Online Team[/b]

notes.title: [Server Maintenance] April 9th 2025, 20:00 EST
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11526171/504b044d52a8bcfe55d450373d0c12accbb68d05.png[/img]

Please be aware that on April 9th, we will be having a scheduled maintenance on Knight Online servers. During maintenance game services and web portal will be temporarily unavailable.

Maintenance time will be as follows:

Knight Online Server Time (EST): 20:00
South America (PET): 20:00
Turkey: 04:00


You can find the details regarding the server maintenance on [b]April 9th, 2025[/b], below.

[h3][b][ New Events ][/b][/h3]
* [url=https://www.nttgameonline.com/knight/en/news/news_detail/1194][b]Knight Marble[/b][/url] event has started. [b](4 Weeks)[/b]
* [url=https://www.nttgameonline.com/knight/en/news/news_detail/1196][b]Manes' Arena[/b][/url] event has started. [b](4 Weeks)[/b]

* Wild Grass event has started. [b](4 Weeks)[/b]
- You can hunt "Wild Grass" event monsters located in front of Moradon entrance and obtain the "Wild Grass" item.
- Deliver [b]10x "Wild Grass"[/b] items to [b][Lunar Lady] Magpie[/b] NPC to receive 4 Rice Cakes as a reward.
 
[b]Rice Cake types and their effects:[/b]
- [b]Mugwort Rice Cake[/b] - Attack 5%
- [b]Cactus Rice Cake[/b] - Defense 40
- [b]Pumpkin Rice Cake[/b]- NP 4
- [b]Gardenia Rice Cake[/b] - HP 250
[b]- Rice Cake items will be deleted after the event ends.[/b]

* Giant Earthworm Event [b](4 Weeks)[/b] - The Giant Earthworm will spawn every 8 hours in the Eslant map. Hunt it to earn various rewards!

[b]​[img]https://filegate.nttgame.com/knight/images/upload/vgfcDj7MNUptuhx.png[/img][/b]
- Players near the Giant Earthworm when it dies will receive an EXP reward.
- The first 7 players/parties who attack the Giant Earthworm will receive 50 NP based on their damage contribution.
- Players attacking the Giant Earthworm will have a chance to obtain the [b]"Certificate of Defeating a Slightly Large Earthworm"[/b] item, which can be exchanged with [b][Lunar Lady] Magpie[/b] NPC for a random reward.
 
[b]Possible rewards:[/b]
- Mugwort Rice Cake / 3
- Cactus Rice Cake / 3
- Pumpkin Rice Cake / 3
- Gardenia Rice Cake / 3
- Magic Hammer 30
- Oreads Voucher 7 Days
- Ibex Potion 25
- Crisis Potion 25
- Lunar Tattoo Voucher 7 Days
[u][b]- Rice Cake items will be deleted after the event ends.[/b][/u]
 
* [b]I will continue playing Knight Online[/b] event is back![b](4 Weeks)[/b]
- Players who obtain 20 or more "I will continue playing Knight Online" emblems via Akara's Altar between [b]April 9th - May 7th[/b] will receive [b]"Chaos Guardian Transformation Exchange Ticket (Non-tradeable)"[/b] after the May 7th maintenance.
- The Chaos Guardian Transformation Scroll will transform your character into El Morad/Karus models from the Chaos event, depending on your race. You will receive 30 of them.
- Rewards not claimed from the in-game mail system will be deleted after 30 days.

[h3][b][ [Event Manager] Aset Updates ][/b][/h3]
* [b]Pathos' Gloves [/b]and[b] HP/Armor/Attack Scroll packages[/b] are now available from [b][Event Manager] Aset[/b]!
- [b]2x 30-Day Pathos Gloves[/b] - 60,000,000 Noah
- [b]2200 HP + Armor 380 Scroll Pack[/b] - 60,000,000 Noah
- [b]2200 HP + Armor 380 + Attack Scroll Pack [/b]- 75,000,000 Noah
 
[b]* New Weapons: Steel Lion Weapons![/b]
[img]https://filegate.nttgame.com/knight/images/upload/H1N3GwhAzrbpaU5.png[/img]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=a5dxepmAsGM

- You now have a chance to obtain [b]Steel Lion Weapons[/b] from the [b]"Steel Lion[/b]
[b] Weapon Box"[/b], purchasable for [b]15,000,000 Noah[/b] from [b][Event Manager] Aset. [/b]
You can buy and open the box via the "Box Purchase or Open" menu.
[img]https://filegate.nttgame.com/knight/images/upload/nyW1StBxhNUepvz.png[/img]
- Steel Lion weapons are equivalent in power to Under the Castle event weapons.
[b]- Steel Lion Weapon Box will be available from April 9th ~ May 7th.[/b]

[b]- Steel Lion weapon types and their +1 stats:[/b]
[img]https://filegate.nttgame.com/knight/images/upload/uq9PeNE17bg3L6F.jpg[/img]
* [b]Ring of the Felankor Draw[/b] option added to [b][Event Manager] Aset[/b] NPC [b](4 Weeks)[/b]
- [b]Between April 9th ~ May 7th[/b], you can try your luck to obtain [b]Ring of the Felankor[/b] via the "Ring of the Felankor Draw" option in the "Box Purchase or Open" menu for [b]15.000.000 Noah.[/b]
[b]- If you select the option and press "Yes," the draw will take place immediately.[/b]

[h3][b][ System, UI, and Other Changes ][/b][/h3]
* [b]Special Oreads fairies added to the game![/b]
- Special Oreads fairies combine the auto-loot ability of normal Oreads with the features of Special Nereids fairies.
- You can combine an Oreads and a Nereids at [b][Vendor] Kaira[/b] in Moradon via "Exchanging Items > [Exchange] [Spirit's Help] > [Waking Up the Special Oreads]."
- To craft Special Oreads (Attack), you will need 1 Oreads Voucher + 1 Special Nereids (Attack) Voucher.
- To craft Special Oreads (Defense), you will need 1 Oreads Voucher + 1 Special Nereids (Defense) Voucher.
[b]- Only Voucher versions of fairies can be combined. Activated fairies cannot be used.[/b]

notes.title: [Server Maintenance] March 26th 2025, 20:00 EST
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11526171/504b044d52a8bcfe55d450373d0c12accbb68d05.png[/img]

Please be aware that on March 26th, we will be having a scheduled maintenance on Knight Online servers. During maintenance game services and web portal will be temporarily unavailable.

Maintenance time will be as follows:

Knight Online Server Time (EST): 20:00
South America (PET): 20:00
Turkey: 04:00

You can find the details regarding the server maintenance on [b]26.03.2025[/b] below.

[h3][b][ New Events ][/b][/h3]
* [b]Ronark Land Bowl Lupus Boss Event[/b] has started! [b](4 Weeks)[/b]
* The Lupus Boss will appear every 3 hours.
* The respawn time may randomly vary forward or backward.
* The same items as the old Lupus Boss will drop.
 
* [b]Daily Coin Exchange Event[/b] is here! [b](4 Weeks)[/b]
[img]https://filegate.nttgame.com/knight/images/upload/NnkDXUyKWemVaA7.png[/img]
For 4 weeks, by participating in the Juraid Mountain event, you can obtain [b]2 "Daily Coin" items if you win and 1 if you lose[/b].
- By collecting [b]30x Daily Coin[/b] items and delivering them to the [b]NPC [Fortune Teller] Mekin[/b], you will earn a quest reset right after the server maintenance on [u][b]April 23rd.[/b][/u]
- Only characters that deliver 30 Daily Coin items will benefit from the quest reset. [u][b]The reset is not account-based.[/b][/u]
[u][b]- The "Daily Coin" items used in the event will be deleted at the end of the event.[/b][/u]

[h3][b][ System, Interface, and Other Changes ][/b][/h3]
* Some attack priority adjustments have been made on Genie.
- The issue where the Rogue class could not use ranged skills when "Blow Arrow" was set as the primary skill on Genie has been fixed.
- For example, if "Blow Arrow" is the first skill and "Arc Shot" is the second skill in the Genie > Attack tab, Genie will now use "Arc Shot" if the monster is out of range for "Blow Arrow."
- A similar adjustment has been made for the Mage class' "Manes of Fire" skill.
* In the "Command Menu" opened with the "H" key, the "BlockList" option has been renamed to "Merchant Block."
* The chance of obtaining Tyon Meat while hunting Tyon has been increased.
* The NPC sale price of Tyon Meat has been reduced to 250 noah.
* The Farm Guard quest in the Tyon area has been removed.
* The Inn Hostess NPC location for the El Morad side in the Border Defense War map has been adjusted.
* The Rogue class' "Smoke Screen" skill has been modified to only affect the enemy race. Additionally, its duration has been set to 3 seconds, and its cooldown has been set to 3 minutes.
* The number of simultaneous attacks performed by "Guard Towers" in Ronark Land has been reduced, but their damage has been increased.
* Various text corrections have been made for item names and their skill bar names.
*  Improvements made to character level of detail and multi-thread performance.

[h3][b][ Upcoming Events ][/b][/h3]
* [b]"I will continue playing Knight Online" Event[/b] is coming soon!  
- [u][b]Between April 10 and May 8[/b][/u], players who obtain 20 or more "I will continue playing Knight Online" emblems from Akara's Altar will receive a [b]"Chaos Guardian Transformation Exchange Ticket (Non-tradeable)"[/b] after the server maintenance on May 8th.  
- The Chaos Guardian Transformation Scroll changes your character's appearance to El Morad / Karus characters from Chaos event. After exchanging the ticket for your character's race, you will receive 30x scrolls pack.​
- Rewards not collected from the in-game mail system will be deleted after 30 days.

[h3][b][ Ended Events ][/b][/h3]
- The Ronark Land Lobo Boss Spawn Event has ended.
- The Daily Coin2 Exchange Event has ended.
- The Eslant [Daily Party] Quest EXP Increase Event has ended.
 
Have fun!
[b]NTTGame | Knight Online Team[/b]

During the 4 weeks, by participating in the Juraid Mountain event, you will receive 2 "Daily Coin2" items if you win, and 1 if you lose.

- Each account can participate only once. The item is non-tradeable/non-sellable.
- "Daily Coin2" items used in the event will be deleted after the event ends.
 
* Eslant [Daily Party] Quest EXP Boost Event (4 Weeks)
[Reserve Knight] Lily's [Daily Party] Demonic Legion of Eslant quest series, which you can take while in a party, will provide more EXP for 4 weeks!
- [Daily Party] Demonic Legion of Eslant (Destruction) and (Lust) Quests: 5,000,000 > 10,000,000 EXP
- [Daily Party] Demonic Legion of Eslant (Nightmare) and (Chaos) Quests: 7,000,000 > 15,000,000 EXP
During the event period, completing all 4 of these daily quests will yield a total of 50m EXP instead of 24m!

* The number of items that gets listed in the "Repurchase Sold or Destroyed items" menu, which allows you to retrieve discarded items from [Grand Merchant] Kaishan, has been increased from 20 to 50.

- Transformation Totem
- Philum +6

- Options > Game Option2 > "Turn on Y-key Walking Mode." If this option is checked, pressing "Y" will switch between walking and running.
- If unchecked, pressing "Y" will no longer switch to walking mode.
* The chance to obtain items from monsters within the Ardream map has been removed. Only Noah will continue to be obtainable from the monsters on the Ardream map.

* Tooltip texts for many items have been revised/updated. This change does not affect item properties; it only corrects typographical/translation errors.
* Passive skill descriptions for Warrior and Kurian classes have been corrected.
- This change only affects the skill descriptions; there are no changes to skill mechanics or percentages.

- Warrior: Hinder, Arrest, Bulwark, Evading, Iron Skin, Iron Body
- Kurian: Arrest, Bulwark, Evading, Iron Skin, Iron Linker

- Based on the monthly ranking/ladder standings for March, extra rewards will be given to players on all servers after maintenance on April 10.

A giant spinning top has appeared on the Eslant map of each race. It's waiting for you to spin and earn rewards!

WAR Premium (1 Day) - Non-tradable, non-sellable, non-storable. 

Players who manage to acquire the box from the final form of the spinning top will have the chance to get the "User Buff Pet Scroll Exchange Voucher - HP increase (15 Days)" item and a random one of the items listed below.

notes.title: [Server Maintenance] October 23rd 2024, 20:00 EST
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11526171/504b044d52a8bcfe55d450373d0c12accbb68d05.png[/img]

Please be aware that on October 23rd, we will be having a scheduled maintenance on Knight Online servers. During maintenance game services and web portal will be temporarily unavailable.

Maintenance time will be as follows:

Knight Online Server Time (EST): 20:00
South America (PET): 20:00
Turkey: 4:00

You can find the details regarding the server maintenance on October 23rd, 2024 below.

* Coin Event has started! (4 Weeks)
* Knight Royale Event has started! (4 Weeks)
* Halloween Events has started! (4 Weeks)

* Sales of War Hero Wings, Lunar Tattoo and Equipment View Item has started on NPC Aset! (4 Weeks)
- War Hero Wing (30 Days) & Lunar Tattoo (30 Days) – 190m Noah
- War Hero Wings (30 Days) – 90m Noah
- Lunar Tattoo (30 Days) 120m Noah
- Equipment View Item (10 piece) – 5m Noah

* Country flags and fireworks got added to the sundries (4 weeks)
For the upcoming Republic Day of Turkey, country flags and fireworks got added to the Sundries NPCs in the game!

* Lunar War enemy nation invasion has returned!
With this change, the war map period of Lunar War will take 30 minutes to end, after the war ends, there will be a 30-minute period for the winner to invade the enemy nation. The total war duration is 1 hour long.
- Nereidth Island victory conditions got changed.
With the change, if one side occupies 10 occupied areas during the first 15 minutes of the war, the war winner will be decided at 15-minute mark of the war, instead of the previous 30-minute mark.
- If the war ends early in some maps (e.g. Nereidth Island map), the remaining time will be added to the invasion.
For example, if the war ends in 15 minutes on the Nereidth Island map, enemy invasion period will be 45 minutes instead.
- Chat kill message announcements got added to the Luferson / Elmorad Castle maps to be active during invasions.

* An option to swap Enhanced Silver Gem got added to the Juraid Mountain entrance NPCs [Reserve Knight Captain] Belldan / [Reserve Knight Captain] Rugur in the Eslant map.

- By using the “Enhanced Silver Gem Exchange List” button on the NPC, you can exchange your Fortified Sterling Silver Gemstone for a Silvery Gem if you'd wish to.
The exchange rate is 1:1 and you could only exchange Sterling Silver Gemstones for Silvery Gems.

* Fortified Sterling Silver Gemstone have been updated.
- Minotaur's Earring, Cockatrice's Earrings, Lich King's Earring, and Lillime's Earrings have been removed from the Fortified Sterling Silver Gemstone. Only the Fortified versions of these accessories will be obtainable through the Fortified Sterling Silver Gemstone now.
- The Fortified versions of the mentioned accessories can still be obtained.
- This change only applies to the Fortified Sterling Silver Gemstone. The normal versions of these accessories can still be obtained through the Silvery Gem.

- The drop rates for Fortified accessories have been increased!
With the removal of the regular versions of the mentioned accessories from the Fortified Sterling Silver Gemstone, their drop rate percentages have been added on top of the existing drop rates of Fortified Minotaur's Earring, Fortified Cockatrice's Earrings, Fortified Lich King's Earring, and Fortified Lillime's Earrings. With this, chances of obtaining these items from the Sterling Silver Gemstone got increased.

* Juraid Mountain's matchmaking system got updated
- With this change, higher level users will have the priority of entry, additionally on the same level bracket, whoever applied first will have the entry priority.
For example, If there are 1 character on Elmorad side and 2 characters on Karus side during the matchmaking period that are all 83 level, on the Karus side, whichever character applied 1st will be taken to the event and whoever applied 2nd will not be able to enter.
In the case of level difference, If there are one character on Elmorad side and 2 Characters on Karus side, If the first character that applied to the event on the Karus side is Level 80 and the one that applied second is level 83, the 83 level character will have the right of entry to the event.
Rebirth levels are not taken into consideration for this matchmaking method.
The method of assigning team members to your party in the event will continue to be random, regardless of the order of application.

* Price History List changes
​- The price list function will now display the last update date for the price data of the item you have searched for.
- The issue where data for the item you have previously searched for being displayed when you re-opened the price list UI got fixed.

* Various quest text errors got corrected.

* Puzzle Event has ended.
* Full Moon Rift Event has ended.
* Sales of Ibexs, Crisis, Buff pet scrolls, Resurrection Scroll 90% and Special Nereids items on NPC Aset has ended.

Have fun,​
NTTGame | Knight Online Team

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11526171/504b044d52a8bcfe55d450373d0c12accbb68d05.png[/img]

Please be aware that on October 9th, we will be having a scheduled maintenance on Knight Online servers. During maintenance game services and web portal will be temporarily unavailable.

* Some objects got moved slightly away from mob spawn areas in Eslant's Glacial (213,128 Coordinates) and Desert (905,303 Coordinates) zones to avoid objects blocking attacks to mobs.

* An issue causing Party HP bars to get stuck on some debuff indicator colors even after debuff gets removed got fixed.
* It is now possible search items with multiple words instead of only 1 word on the Power Up Store.​

- Rings of the Cool-Headed King -> Amulet of the Cool-Headed King
- Rings of the Intelligent King -> Amulet of the Intelligent King
- Rings of the Wise King -> Amulet of the Wise King

Have fun,
NTTGame | Knight Online Team

notes.title: [Server Maintenance] September 25th 2024, 20:00 EST
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11526171/504b044d52a8bcfe55d450373d0c12accbb68d05.png[/img]

Please be aware that on September 25th, we will be having a scheduled maintenance on Knight Online servers. During maintenance game services and web portal will be temporarily unavailable.

Maintenance time will be as follows:

Knight Online Server Time (EST): 20:00
South America (PET): 20:00
Turkey: 4:00

You can find the details regarding the server maintenance on September 25th, 2024 below.
 
* Puzzle Event has started!
* Full Moon Rift Event has started!
 
* Ibexs and Crisis Potions have been added to the NPC Aset. (4 Weeks)
- Normally, Ibexs can be purchased for 70m and Crisis for 105m. (When purchased this way, the potions come as tradable.)
- With DC Premium/War Premium, Ibexs can be purchased for 55m and Crisis for 80m. (When purchased this way, the pots come as non-tradable.)

* Buff Pet Scroll, which you can purchase for 50m / 50m / 60m Noah in variations of HP 200 / AC 20 / Atk 5, have been added to the NPC Aset. (4 Weeks)

* Resurrection Scroll 90%, which you can purchase for 60m Noah, have been added to the NPC Aset. (4 Weeks)

* Special Nereids, which you can purchase for 90m Noah in Attack/Defense variations, have been added to the NPC Aset. (4 Weeks)

 
* Mailbox Got Improved!
The account and character mailboxes are now available separately.
- You can find the type of mails/items that are tied to your account from “Account” tab on the mailbox (e.g. Some PUS items that gets sent to mail after claiming, the Trina's Piece item that you receive as a gift with certain premium types etc.)
- You can view mails that are tied to your character under the “Character” tab 
-  You can search your mails now!
- With the improvements made to the mailbox, now you can simply search for the item, sender or mail title to find the related mail you're looking for in your mailbox.
- The maximum number of mails you can see for both categories are now 50.
 
* You can now join, leave, authorize members as co-leaders or transfer the clan leadership in Eslant, Ronark Land and Ardream zones as well!
 
* A new [Quest] Monster got added to the Eslant area.
- A new quest monster, [Quest] Raven Harpy has been added to the Eslant area, which drops the quest item “Relic of a Hero”. It does not drop any other items that normal Raven Harpies has, like Mirage Daggers.
- The [Quest] Raven Harpy monsters can be only seen when “[Failed Mission] Belongings of deceased Great Knight” quest is active. 
- The [Quest] version of Raven Harpy is easier to defeat than the regular Raven Harpy.
- “Relic of a Hero” quest item can no longer be obtained from the regular Raven Harpy.
 
* A warning message has been added to the name change menu on [Vendor] Hermes. When you attempt to use non-alpha numeric characters on the nickname you are attempting to change to, you will get an informative message that points out you may not use it.
 
* Incorrect locations for some monsters and NPCs on the world map (M) got fixed.
* The issue where some quest dialogues were appearing cut off got fixed.
* The issue where the quest progress tooltip sometimes appeared strangely with half of it transparent got fixed.
* The lootable noah amounts of monsters inside the "Monster Suppression Squad II" Quest has been reduced.
 
- Arena of Manes Event has ended.
- Knight Marble Event has ended.
- The limited time sale of [Limited] Pathos' Glove and Limited Edition Buff Scroll items on NPC [Event Manager] Aset has ended.
- The Kitchen Thieves Event has ended.

Have fun,
​
NTTGame | Knight Online Team

notes.title: [Server Maintenance] August 28 2024, 20:00 EST
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11526171/504b044d52a8bcfe55d450373d0c12accbb68d05.png[/img]

Please be aware that on August 28, we will be having a scheduled maintenance on Knight Online servers. During maintenance game services and web portal will be temporarily unavailable.

Maintenance time will be as follows:
Knight Online Server Time (EST): 20:00
South America (PET): 20:00
Turkey: 4:00

You can find the details regarding the server maintenance on August 28th, 2024 below;

* The [url=https://www.nttgameonline.com/knight/en/news/news_detail/1104]Knight Marble[/url] event has started! (4 weeks)
* The [url=https://www.nttgameonline.com/knight/en/news/news_detail/1106]Arena of Manes[/url] event has started! (4 weeks)

* The sale of [Limited] Pathos' Glove and Limited Edition Buff Scroll items has started on NPC [Event Manager] Aset!
- 2 x 30-Day Pathos Glove - 60,000,000 Coins
- 2200 HP + Armor 380 Scroll Package - 60,000,000 Coins
- 2200 HP + Armor 380 + Attack Scroll Package - 75,000,000 Coins

* The Kitchen Thieves Event has started! (4 weeks)
- The Yellow Spitz creatures in front of Moradon have stolen food ingredients! Catch them and deliver 10 food ingredients to [Lunar Lady] Magpie daily.
​
- With the Mysterious Firecracker item that Magpie NPC gives you, you can summon a random creature and receive your reward.

You can find the creatures that may appear and their possible drops below:
Haetae - Mugwort Rice Cake, Cactus Rice Cake, Gardinia Rice Cake, and Pumpkin Rice Cake
Yellow Spitz - Stellar Tattoo (1-Day)
Escaped Turkey - Nimbus Tattoo (1-Day)
Leftover Bone - Monster Stone
Yellow Spitz Owner - Lunar Tattoo (1-Day)

* The Edit Merchant feature has been added to the game!
Whether you want to edit a selling merchant or a buying merchant, after setting up your shop, you can now use this feature to edit your shop instead of re-adding all the items from scratch!
- While in merchant mode, you can start editing your shop by selecting the “Edit_Merchant” option under the “Trade” category in the menu opened with the H key or by typing the /edit_merchant command in the chat.
- To use the feature, your character must already be in merchant mode.
- While editing, your character will exit merchant mode. When you finish editing, your character will re-enter merchant mode at the same spot with the changes made.
- After entering edit mode, there is a 1-minute cooldown before you can re-enter merchant mode.

* A favorites menu has been added for Buying Merchant!
Now, you can add your desired items to the 'Favorites' section on the Buying Merchant menu, allowing you to set up your shop more easily during your next market session!
- You can add any item to the Favorites menu by searching for the item on the Buying Merchant menu, selecting the item, and clicking the “Add Favorites” button.
- You can add up to 20 items to the Favorites menu.

* Two Guard Towers have been added to the front of the safe zones of both races in PvP Area / Deva Room in the Juraid Mountain event.
- If you die to a Guard Tower during the event, you will not lose EXP.
- If you die to a Guard Tower, your death will not give the opposing team a score.

* Rogue's Wild Advent and Warrior's Descent skills are now useable in Border Defense War event.
- You cannot use Wild Advent / Descent skills if your character or the character you are attempting to use the skills on is is actively carrying the Altar.

* The number of items required for the Collection of Weapon Materials, Food Shortage 2, and Daughter's Present quests has been reduced from 20 to 5.
* The number of items required for the Ecosystem Research 1 quest has been reduced from 15 to 5.
* The drop rates of certain quest items have been increased.
* The Ape Prison Key, Lamia's Mirror, Tentacle, and Black Silk Bundle items have been removed from the drop list.
* The NPC sale prices for the Animal Blood, Rotten Eye, Silver Feather, Coarse Ground Bone, and Oath of Darkness items have been reduced.
* The issue where the previously entered Noah amount reappeared in the Noah menu during a trade has been resolved.
* New spawn areas for Savage, Hornet, Lamia, Uruk Hai, Uruk Blade, Uruk Tron, and Grell have been added to the Elmorad and Luferson maps with two monster spawns on each location. The two-monster spawn areas are near the normal spawn points of each monster.
* The Temporary Item List interface has been updated to automatically close if a time-limited item expires and is deleted immediately after logging into the game.
* The issue where the resurrection selection UI appeared despite dying to monsters that does not cause experience loss has been resolved.

* Text updates:
- The warning message that appears when you cannot enter the Juraid Mountain event due to insufficient party members or enemy players has been updated to “You have been rejected because of insufficient enemy players or party members.”

South America (PET): 20:00

NTTGame | Knight Online Team

[b]Server maintenance, which was planned to be carried out on August 15, has been moved to August 12, 2024.[/b]

You can find the details regarding the server maintenance on July 17, 2024 below.

* Lupus Boss will appear every 3 hours in the Ronark Land Bowl area. (The respawn time may change randomly forward or backward.) (July 17th ~ August 12th)
- The same items as the old Lupus boss will drop.
 
* Daily Coin Exchange Event has started! (July 17th ~ August 12th)
- Collect 30 “Daily Coin” items and deliver them to [Fortune Teller] Mekin NPC to receive "Blessed Talisman Enhancement Item - Untradable" once per account.
- You can earn 2 Daily Coins by winning and 1 Daily Coins by losing the Juraid Mountain event.
- Each account can participate only once. The item cannot be traded or sold.
- With the "Blessed Talisman Enhancement Item," you can upgrade the level of your "Talisman of Courage" or "Talisman of Spirit" items to one level above with a 100% chance.
The item can be used up to +11 for Talisman of Spirit and +21 for Talisman of Courage.
- The event "Daily Coin" item will be removed at the end of the event.
 
* The counting system of monster hunting quests has been changed.
- Now, to increase the kill count in hunting quests, you or someone in your party does not need to make the last hit on the monster. Attacking the monster at least once will be enough to increase the kill count.
- PvP quests where you need to kill the opposing race ([Daily Account] 7th Armor Quest etc.) are not included in this system. In these types of quests, you have to be the one who makes the last blow and kills the opposing race.​
- In hunting quests, if you do not attack at all and only use Guard Summon/Pet to kill the monster, the kill count will not increase.
As long as you attack along with the Guard Summon/Pet, the kill count will increase normally.
 
* The entry method to Juraid Mountain has been updated.
- High-level players will be prioritized, and party member assignments will be made randomly, regardless of application order.

* The visuals of old Warrior/Mage/Priest/Rogue Earring items have been updated.
* A zoom in/out option has been added to the Appearance Change interface.
* Commas have been added to the Ladder Point numbers on the leaderboard in the PvP zones for better readability.
* The Trophy of Flame has been removed from the Buy Merchant/Price search etc. sections as the item is non-tradable.
* The mouse scroll wheel can now be used on Menisia's official list item.
* The issue of text overflowing outside the interface when sending a Whisper has been fixed.
* The issue where players could not enter Monster Stone after leaving the Ultima event has been fixed.
 

* The Ronark Land Lobo Boss event has ended.
* The limited-time Juraid Mountain Achievement event has ended. Rewards have been sent to players who unlocked the achievement.
- Reward letters will be deleted on August 12th, please claim your rewards before then.
* The special EXP, Ladder Points, and National Points event for the holiday has ended.
 
Have fun,
NTTGame | Knight Online Team

* Monthly Ranking Event! Extra gifts will be given to our players on all servers according to the monthly rank/ladder rankings in July.​

* EXP, Ladder Points, and National Points Event has started! (4 Weeks)
- Between June 19 and July 17, from 18:00 to 02:00 Server Time, a 50% EXP, +10 NP, and +10 Ladder Point event will be active every day.
 
* Lobo Boss will appear every 3 hours in the Ronark Land Bowl area. (The respawn time may change randomly forward or backward.) (4 Weeks)
- The same items drop as from the old Lobo boss.

* The respawn event for extra Eslant bosses in the Ronarkland Bowl area has become permanent!
- Eslant bosses will appear scattered in the bowl area during boss hours.
- Boss rewards are the same as Eslant bosses.
- Box drop chances are the same as in the Eslant map.
- Boss monsters will continue to respawn in the Eslant map.
 
* Limited-time Juraid Mountain Achievement Event has started. (4 Weeks)
- Characters who participate in the Juraid Mountain event and win or lose a total of 20 times will receive the “2024 Exclusive Achievement Juraid” achievement. Characters who obtained the achievement will be automatically registered for the event and will receive the non-tradable “Redistribution Item.” at July 18 server maintenance. (Items that did not get claimed from the mail system will be deleted on August 13.)
- To progress in the achievement, you need to enter the Juraid Mountain event and complete it. Both wins and losses will contribute to the achievement.
- Only 1 Redistribution Item will be sent even if the event is completed by more than one character.

* The issue where the Kaul transformation effect in “Trainer Kate” staff variants could not be reverted when Bezoar/Glutinous Rice Cake is in use has been resolved.
* Skills can no longer be cast from within or from behind objects.
* The Kaul Mother that appears on Mora Island will now disappear if not killed within 2 hours.
* The Buying Merchant interface has been adjusted. The sizes of the “Item Select” and “Upgrade” selection menus have been adjusted.
* Color change palette UI have been improved.
- The ability to manually enter RGB values when selecting a color have been added to the color picker.
- This change has been applied to all color selection palette menus, including buying capes, creating characters, etc.
- When changing the character's appearance, the hair color cannot be changed to RGB (0, 0, 0).
* The issue where NPC location info windows or Seed/Max notifications would randomly appear on the screen for quests that could not be completed has been resolved.
* An arrangement has been made so that PUS cannot be opened while Genie is active.
* A change has been made to MP/HP Weapons' recovery feature, previously MP/HP features remained active even when the MP/HP Recovery weapon had 0 Durability and was broken. Now, if your MP/HP Recovery weapon's Durability reaches 0, the Recovery feature will be disabled unless you repair your weapon.
* The issue where clan leadership was not properly transferred when assigned to another player has been fixed.
* The issue where the interface for clan leader-specific buttons did not become visible until the interface was closed and reopened after transferring clan leadership has been resolved.

77-78 -> Blue Gem
79-80 -> Yellow Gem
81-82 -> Red Gem

* War Board system has been added to the game.

- To go to the first page, you need to press the "TOP" button at the bottom.

- The system displays the user with the highest damage or healing amount as 100% and displays the remaining users' damage or healing amount as a percentage.
- The color of the indicator is displayed in different colors for each class and your indicator is highlighted with a blinking effect.
- In the Juraid Mountain and BDW war, a separate War Board is opened for each group.

* Fixed the issue where the Knight Royale login UI window becomes active again when the number of participants is refreshed while the map is open.

* Some updates have been made to the sound system.

* Genie hammer and Magic hammer items have been removed from being added to the genie attack Tab section.

Please be aware that we will be conducting scheduled maintenance on Steam Knight Online Servers and service will be temporarily unavailable.

Maintenance time will be as follows:
Knight Online Server Time (EST): 21:00
South America (PET): 20:00
Turkey: 4:00

Duration: Approx. 2 hours

[b]Patch Notes;[/b]

Hail Knights,

During this server maintenance;

* Twisted Moradon event has started.

* Special Defense Scroll items that you can buy from NPC Aset have been added to the game. These items, which you can get for 30,000,000 Noah, provide 3 defense increases against the weapon type you choose.
[url=https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/562613479047954433/890460666085929000/unknown.png] Special Defense Scroll [/url]

* Minerva item sale has started, which you can get for 50,000,000 Noah from NPC Aset!

* Prayer of Priest item is also available for sale via Aset. When the item is purchased from Aset, it gives +55% attack. You can buy it for 30,000,000 Million coins. (Applies to the Priest class.)
[url=https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/347287347475251202/971259375685623878/unknown.png] Prayer of Priests [/url]

* Puzzle event has been started.
[url=https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/347287347475251202/1017270700211449936/unknown.png] Puzzle Event [/url]

* Kitchen Thief event has been started.
- Yellow Spitz creatures in front of Moradon have stolen food supplies! Catch them and deliver 10 food ingredients to [Lunar Lady] Magpie daily.
[url=https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/347287347475251202/1017270358878998539/unknown.png] Kitchen Thief [/url]

- With Mysterious Firecracker item that Magpie will give you, you can reveal a random creature and get your reward.
* Haetae - Mugwort Rice Cake, Cactus Rice Cake, Gardinia Rice Cake and Pumpkin Rice Cake
* Yellow Spitz - Stellar Tattoo 1 Day
* Escaped Turkey - Nimbus Tattoo 1 Day
* Leftover Bone - Monster Stone
* Yellow Spitz Owner - Lunar Tattoo 1 Day

** Mysterious Firecracker, Mugwort Rice Cake, Cactus Rice Cake, Gardinia Rice Cake, and Pumpkin Rice Cake items will be deleted when the event ends

* Function of using the Mini HP indicator in its old form has been added.
[url=https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/347361018554613762/1017259646764990536/hud.gif] Mini HP Bar [/url]

* Adjusted the issue of players who applied early in the BDW event falling into the empty room.

* Find the Spy quest can now be completed without having to collect 4 people. You will receive rewards equal to the amount of spies you collect.

Have fun!
[b]NTTGame || Knight Online Team[/b]

* Lycaon Boss will spawn every 3 hours in the Ronark Land Bowl area. (Respawn time may vary randomly forward or backward.)
- Same items drop as old Lycaon boss.

* Lupus boss event has ended.

* Edits and bug fixes related to Manes' Arena Event;
- Fixed the Potion issue in the event.
- Fixed the long distance hitting issue.
- The problem of disappearing basic skills has been fixed.
- The respawn time has been updated to 10 seconds.

- Bonus selection feature will now appear 3 times for the player with the lowest score during the event.
- The amount of bonus points received during the event has been increased from 300 to 500.

* Removed two quests from Ronark Land [Analyst] NPC.
- Take the Secret Document of enemies?
- Distrubing the Enemy Base in Ronark Land

* Fixed the issue where you could not teleport to the Monster Stone map after entering the BDW event.

* Adjusted the issue of players who applied early in the BDW event falling into the empty room.

* Fixed the issue where the Transformation Totem item could not be used in the Skill registration system.

* Added a 3 second delay to the use of the "Low to High" rank in the Menicia List item.

* The attack of Hepa's Blade Ax has been increased by +8.

* UTC, Bifrost and Krowaz events will not be accessed with the same ip.

* When you disconnect on the Krowaz map, you will respawn on the Ronark Land map.

* Quest items have been deleted.
- Fang of Bakirra
- Gavolt Wing
- Cursed Bone
- Feather of Harpy Queen
- Holy Water of Temple

* Title Ruler of Draki's Tower Exchange can now be exchanged for a 30-Day Solar Tattoo via [Priest] Sol/Ann NPCs. Solar Tattoo comes broken, ready to use.

* Fixed the problem that the person who is added to the Friend list in the Chaos event appears with a different color.

* The UI has been edited for the HP/MP indicator bar on the screen.

* Whisper conversations are now changed to appear on the right and left.
- The texts you write will be on the right, and the texts of the person you are talking to will be on the left.

* Some NPC's menu windows will spawn in random places on your screen.

* The size of Draki and Ronark Land El-Rasaga boss has been increased.

* Fixed some quest and item typos.

* Removed Blue/Red potion options in Lunar War battle.

* The Soul Of Despair item will no longer drop.

* In order to use the Scroll of teleport Friend, both sides must add to the friend list.

Have fun!
NTTGame || Knight Online Team

Please be aware that we will be conducting scheduled maintenance on Steam Knight Online Servers and service will be temporarily unavailable.

Maintenance time will be as follows:
Knight Online Server Time (EST): 21:00
South America (PET): 20:00
Turkey: 4:00

Duration: Approx. 4 hours

Hail Knights,

During this server maintenance;

* Monthly Ranking Gifts were sent to our winners.

* A Lupus Boss will spawn every 3 hours in the Ronark Land Bowl area. (Respawn time may vary randomly forward or backward.)
- Same items drop as old Lupus boss.

* The BDW Event will randomly generate a party from the participating players.

* The entry system for Forgotten Temple and UTC events has been changed.
- You can apply to participate in the event via NPC 10 minutes before the start of the event.
- 50% of the players who can enter the event will be chosen randomly from the players who applied first, and the remaining 50% from the other players who have applied.
-After the registration period expires, you need to log in to the event again via npc.

* The Lunar War map selection system has been added to the game. Those who will vote in the election will be selected as follows.
- War Hero Warder and Keeper kills or players with the most kills.
- The 10 Elmorad 10 Karus leaders with the most donations and the top 10 players in the contribution ranking will be able to vote.
- Voting will start 2 days before the battle of Lunar War and will be active for 24 hours.

* Arrangements have been made for the areas on the Ronark Land map that drop towns when approached.

* Fixed the issue where the coin sound is not heard when there is any item in the emblem slot.

* Fixed the issue where item levels were displayed in empty slots when creating your own market after opening another player's market.

* Fixed the problem that after blocking the person with the Summon blocking feature, when you enter the party with the same person again, the blocking remains active directly.

* Adjusted for Genie icon FX issues. (Genie icon appearing as an extra under the character and displaced.)

* Juraid Mountain Penalty removal fee updated to 10 million.

* The UI has been updated for NTS use. (There is a limitation in the options related to the Face and Hair options. This limitation will be resolved with the next maintenance.)

* Genie Basic attack on and off feature has been added to the game. (R attack)

* Adjustments have been made regarding Item, Ability and Buff/Debuff texts.

* Renamed Hepa's Iron Crossbow and Iron Crossbow to Vortex Bow.

* The icon of the Magic hammer item has been changed.

* Quest Reset! We wanted to remind you one more time before the Quest are reset.

Have fun!
NTTGame || Knight Online Team

- Normally, Ibex 70m Crisis can be taken as 105m. (When buying in this way, the pots come as tradeable.)

- Cursed Bone

- Take the Secret Document of enemies
- To find the lost soul
- Find the Spy

- Gold Rimmed Blue Treasure Chest

NTTGame || Knight Online Team
